subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands deterministically inject SKILL.md into model context, and what instruction authority should that injected content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes how trusted and untrusted skill instructions enter the agent context and cannot be safely chosen as a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define contract then implement
options.body: Specify SKILL.md authority, filtering, and audit behavior first, then add deterministic injection for eligible explicit slash invocations.

options.title: Keep advisory slash behavior
options.body: Leave ordinary skill slash commands as model-routed requests and document `command-dispatch: tool` as the deterministic path.

options.title: Defer to router/isolation work
options.body: Make this dependent on the broader Skill tool, router, or instruction-isolation design before changing slash behavior.

recommendation.title: Define contract then implement
recommendation.body: Specify SKILL.md authority, filtering, and audit behavior first, then add deterministic injection for eligible explicit slash invocations.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the slash-command skill surface and are the strongest history signal for the owner boundary.
